title: npm client installs with a floating range by default
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that writes a caret range when a dependency is added. Every added dependency starts out accepting unreviewed patch and minor releases, so the manifest drifts away from the version that was tested.
remediation: Set `save-exact=true` and let a deliberate upgrade change the pin.
limitation: It matches a client setting that writes a caret range when a dependency is added in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
